description: On the Steve Hall automotive pricing proposal, David asked to remove the byline because it contained personal information. I anonymized the byline to 'Prepared by Improving' instead of removing the byline block entirely, and left the 'prepared by' framing/discussion in place. David had to correct a second time to get the byline actually removed.
correction: When asked to remove a byline/attribution line entirely, remove the block outright — do not substitute a de-personalized version and treat that as satisfying the request. 'Remove X' means delete X, not rename X.
systemic_fix: When a correction says 'remove' a document element, default to full removal rather than a softened substitute; only keep a modified version if the instruction explicitly asks to change/replace rather than remove.
